svg.title: Baseline, actual and diff images of the Bookshelf catalogue
svg.desc: Three screenshots of the Bookshelf catalogue page side by side. The baseline shows light grey book cards. The actual image shows the same page after a CSS change, with amber cards, rounded corners and a blue Search button. The diff image marks every differing pixel in red, covering the cards and the buttons.
svg.text: this run, after the CSS change
toHaveScreenshot compares the actual image with the baseline and writes the diff next to both when they differ.
